item.description:
• Click the orange globe on a port to show its QR code for your phone
  • Plan usage from claude.ai recovers on its own after your Mac wakes from a long sleep

• Detach the panel into a floating window: place it on any display, resize it, keep it on top
  • Busy days stay readable: extra servers and idle sessions fold away when the panel is full
  • Ports open to your network get an orange badge
  • Open a dev server from your phone: network URL and QR code in the port's menu
  • Quieter health checks: nothing in your server logs unless the panel is open
  • New setting to install updates automatically

• Install script works with macOS's built-in bash
  • Homebrew cask updated for current Homebrew
  • Release notes now written for people, not taken from commits

• tests: platform binary environment may be visible on CI (no SIP)
  • release: Sparkle public key; say which backup is critical
  • release: Sparkle updates, signed DMG workflow, Homebrew cask
  • sessions: Haiku 5 has a 1M context window in the bundled table
  • sessions: context window per model from published models.json
  • settings: fix account initials and Accounts height; fictional sample data
  • settings: refocus after System Settings closes, center on current screen
  • sessions: notify when a session needs you or finishes a long turn
  • settings: global hotkey, theme, menu bar count, login item approval
  • settings: native Settings window with General, Accounts, Notifications, About
  • usage: notify at 75% and 90% and when a heavily used window resets
  • accounts: name orgs like Claude does, hide free orgs without usage
  • accounts: sign in to claude.ai inside portent, per-account usage
  • sessions: "your turn" state and smooth section toggle
  • usage: Claude plan usage, live sessions and running-first panel
  • docker: containers with published ports via the engine socket
  • app: lock projects, relaunch closed ones, stop orphans
  • app: project lanes, health probe, stop tree and popover UI
  • core: process inspection and agent attribution for listening ports
  • app: menu bar skeleton with libproc port scanner
  • spikes: record live Claude usage validation
  • spikes: validate ports, process info, agent sessions and usage sources
